title: About
text:
About Me
      Ask me anything about your data, I promise not to overfit.
      

      
        
          Hi! I'm Tasnim Ara Siddique, a junior at Lawrence University
          (Class of 2027), where I'm building a strong foundation in data analysis, business analytics,
          and statistical computing.My journey in data science began with a curiosity about how numbers tell stories and solve real-world challenges.
        
        
          As a Data Automation Intern at Springer Capital, I work on wealth management analytics, predictive modeling, and sentiment analysis including improving an unsupervised model’s performance by 30% to support strategic decisions.
        
        
          I believe in the power of data to drive positive change and continually explore new techniques to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets.
